criteria.text: Calculates the working capital shortfall as $620,000 and the adjusted Purchase Price as $44,380,000, identifying that the Seller's funds flow figure of $43,760,000 is wrong.

Identifies that the board approval was given at a meeting with only 2 directors present when Article 11 requires a quorum of three, so the approval may be invalid, and recommends a fresh or ratifying resolution.

Identifies the threatened $1,200,000 claim by Foxley Marine Ltd recorded in the board minutes and that it is not disclosed against the litigation warranty (Warranty 7.1), recommending a specific indemnity or price protection.
Lists valid board approval of the transaction as a required approval and states it has not been validly obtained.
Shows the adjustment arithmetic ($45,000,000 - $620,000 = $44,380,000) and flags the discrepancy.
Gives a concrete recommended action for each issue (what to request, amend or negotiate).
